Subject: Request: short-term flexibility on PO mandate for QuickStart pilot

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to get the QuickStart pilot running next week. We have one ask on process: our vendor team is blocked on your PO requirement because our finance cycle won't issue a PO for pilot engagements under $10k.

Would Redwood consider a short-term exception (30 days) where we can be billed via invoice without a PO while we complete technical validation? We can provide vendor intake docs, a signed SOW, and a completed risk questionnaire.

Attached: softbridge-risk-form.pdf, softbridge-bank-w9.pdf

If possible, we'd like to start on Monday (2028-04-22). Please let me know what evidence you need to onboard quickly.

Best,

- We can evaluate a temporary invoice route for pilots, but Procurement needs the standard intake checklist completed and evidence of approval from sales leadership.
- If the exception is approved it will be time-limited (we typically do 30–60 days) and gated on a signed SOW + risk form + payment terms.

Naomi — can you confirm what else you need from Softbridge to move a temporary exception? Marissa — can you confirm commercial approval and which account/project this is billed to so we can create the exception record.

1) Signed one-page SOW (start/end and total $)
2) Completed risk questionnaire (you already attached)
3) Bank/W9 (attached)
4) Point of contact for invoicing and a PO target date if you expect a PO later

Date: 2028-04-16T09:34:00Z
Subject: Procurement checklist for temporary invoice path (Softbridge)

Hi all — I pulled together the minimal checklist we need to approve a short-term no-PO billing lane for pilots. Elaine, thanks for the forms you already sent. Missing items we need to close:

Required to approve exception:
- One-page SOW signed by both parties (include total amount and project code)
- Completed vendor intake (we have the risk questionnaire but need the contact & billing lead fields completed)
- Confirmation of expected PO issuance date or statement that PO will not be issued (we prefer date)
- Credit terms agreement (Net 30 typical; for exceptions we require Net 15 and prepayment is considered for higher risk)

Optional but helpful:
- Internal approval from Softbridge finance confirming invoice route for pilot
- Statement of anticipated annual spend if pilot converts

Process notes: 
- If the evidence above is complete, Procurement will run an expedited risk pass and, barring material issues, issue a documented temporary exception that expires 30 days after the pilot start or when a PO is entered — whichever comes first.
- We will attach the exception to the vendor profile and invoice routing so accounting is aware.

I also attached our exception form template (please see the intake link) and will follow up with a short DocuSign if you confirm the SOW.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

(attachment note: internal exception template referenced on drive; link included in related_links)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@softbridge.ai>
Date: 2028-04-17T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Purchase mandate flex request — approval to proceed under conditions

Elaine / Naomi / Sofia — I've reviewed the ask. Sales approves a temporary exception for Softbridge's QuickStart pilot under the following conditions:

1) Redwood will accept invoices without a PO for the pilot only after we receive the signed one-page SOW and completed intake fields (Naomi's checklist).
2) Exception duration: 30 days from pilot start date (2028-04-22) — auto-expire unless a PO is provided earlier.
3) Payment terms: Net 15 for this exception; invoice to be sent to accounting@softbridge.ai with Redwood invoice references.
4) Softbridge to provide a target PO date no later than 30 days after start. If no PO is forthcoming, Procurement will evaluate continued service on a case-by-case basis.

Naomi — please generate the exception record and attach redwood-temporary-exception-approval-20280417.pdf to the vendor profile. Elaine — please return the signed SOW today so we can get you onboarded Monday.

Sofia — thanks for triaging. Elaine — happy to join a quick call if anything needs clarifying.

Cheers,
